Definition
[Bounded slope condition] 1. ch12:12.41\group chapter-12Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0322 Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb R^2$ be bounded and $\varphi :\partial \Omega \to \mathbb R$. The boundary graph $\Gamma =(\partial \Omega ,\varphi )$ satisfies the bounded slope condition with constant $K$ if, for every $z_0\in \partial \Omega $, there are affine functions \[ \pi _{z_0}^\pm (z) =a^\pm (z_0)\cdot (z-z_0)+\varphi (z_0) \] such that \begin{equation} \tag {12.41} \pi _{z_0}^-(z)\le \varphi (z)\le \pi _{z_0}^+(z) \quad (z\in \partial \Omega ), \qquad |a^\pm (z_0)|\le K. \end{equation}
